text: Aged 18 to 25, in good health; Holding a valid foreign ordinary passport: High school graduation or above (if not graduated at the time of application, a pre-graduation certificate must be provided, and the high school graduation certificate must be obtained at the latest before enrollment). Meet the corresponding language proficiency requirements.Chinese-taught programs: Proof of Chinese proficiency must be submitted. The Chinese proficiency should be equivalent to HSK level 4 or above. Those whose Chinese proficiency does not meet the standard can choose to study in the preparatory course of Xi 'an Jiaotong University. Only those whose Chinese proficiency reaches level 4 of the International Standard of Chinese Language Proficiency after the preparatory course can enter the undergraduate program. Those who fail to meet the standards are not allowed to enter the professional preparatory course. For details, please visit the official website of the International College at: :/sie.xjtu.edu.cn/. English-taught programs: Submit proof of English proficiency. An IELTS score of 6.0 or a TOEFL score of 80 or a Duolingo score of 110 or above, or other equivalent English proficiency certificates recognized by our university. Those whose native language is Chinese or English may be exempted from submitting the corresponding language proficiency certificates upon recognition by our school. To apply for the English-taught program in industrial design, an English to TOLC score of no less than 30 points must also be submitted.It complies with the provisions of the Ministry of Education's Document No. 12 [2020] of the Ministry of Education and the relevant regulations of our university
